integrity: Entire proof is included, with independently executable small-instance tests. This is a self-review and not independent mathematical validation.
scientific_limitations: Only ordinary general position in the sunlet C_n corona K_1 for n at least 4. The next-largest inclusion-maximal size is determined but lower sizes and their multiplicities are not classified. Finite experiments do not establish the infinite assertion; bibliographic priority remains subject to unindexed literature.
title: An isolated maximum in the maximal general-position spectrum of sunlet graphs
